# signoz_saved_view (Data Source)

Fetches a saved view from SigNoz using its UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

data "signoz_saved_view" "get_view" {
  uuid = "abc-123-def"
}

output "saved_view" {
  value = data.signoz_saved_view.get_view
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `uuid` (String) UUID of the saved view.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the saved view.
- `category` (String) Category of the saved view.
- `source_page` (String) Source page of the saved view. Possible values are: logs, traces, and metrics.
- `explorer_data` (String) Explorer data of the saved view as a JSON string.
- `extra_data` (String) Extra data associated with the saved view.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the saved view.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the saved view.
- `created_by` (String) Creator of the saved view.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the saved view.
